M/S. Switz Foods Private Limited & Anr vs Food Safety And
Standards Authority Of ...

8.12.2025
sb Crr 3889 of 2024 with Cran 5 of 2025 M/s. Switz Foods Private Limited & Anr.
Vs.
and Standards Authority of India Ms. Sucheta Mitra Ms. Mandobi Chowdhury Ms.
Priya Malakar ...for the Petitioners Re: Cran 5 of 2025
Affidavit of service filed by the petitioners is taken on record.
Private opposite party is not represented.
Learned counsel for the petitioners prays for restoration and re-imposition of the order passed by this court vide order dated 9.12.2024.

Having heard learned counsel for the petitioners, let the interim order vide order dated 9.12.2024 be restored and re- imposed from this date for a period of twelve weeks or until further order,
whichever is earlier..
CRAN 5 of 2025 is accordingly disposed of.
Re: CRR 3889 of 2024 Let the matter appear in the Monthly list of February, 2026 under the heading "Contested Application".
(Dr. Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J.)
